help_agents_body: An agent keeps how you want a task done: its instructions, the documents it may look at and the tools it may use. Pick one when you start a chat and it works that way every time.
help_agents_example: A “Contract reviewer” that checks every contract you share against your company’s rules.
help_agents_summary: Helpers set up for one kind of task.
help_agents_use_body: Pick an agent when you start a chat to use its instructions, documents and tools. Agents shared with you are ready to use without setting one up yourself.
help_knowledge_body: Put documents and notes into a collection. In a chat, the assistant can look things up in them and shows which document each answer came from.
help_knowledge_example: A “Company handbook” collection, so you can ask how many vacation days you have left.
help_knowledge_summary: Your documents, ready to use in chats.
help_knowledge_use_body: Choose a collection shared with you in a chat. The assistant can look things up in its documents and show where each answer came from.
help_memory_body: The assistant can save small facts you share, like how you like answers written, and use them in later chats. You can see, change or delete them in Settings.
help_memory_example: “I prefer short answers” is remembered, and every later chat keeps to it.
help_memory_summary: Things the assistant remembers about you.
help_schedules_body: Ask for something to happen regularly, like a news summary every weekday at 07:00. Each run starts a new chat, which you can open from the schedule.
help_schedules_example: “Every Monday at 08:00, sum up last week’s news about our industry.”
help_schedules_summary: Tasks that run on their own.
help_skills_body: A skill is a short set of instructions for one kind of job, like reviewing a contract. The assistant uses it on its own when it fits, or when you choose it in a chat.
help_skills_example: A “Meeting notes” skill that turns any transcript into decisions and to-dos.
help_skills_summary: Know-how the assistant picks up when it’s needed.
help_skills_use_body: A skill is a short set of instructions for one kind of job. Choose a skill shared with you in a chat, or let the assistant pick it up when it fits.
